sources.note: Accepted: 2 pieces (1 cut), kind heading+instruction; single-language; 2 in a row the source stores in this language only; lengths 16/90. Wording, diacritics, protected markers and repetition are unchanged.

layout.note: All 3 sources are placed once, in order: 10 output rows, 8 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 40 code points at the median, so the granularity stays in the manual-v1 range. No fused section labels or crossed pairings were found. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre and against the corpus-wide statistics for every item.
